protocol.R: online vector solves minus k; every rejected/refined popped candidate is logged
protocol.uncertified: same compiled initializer, coarse selected-vector tolerance and Sherman-Morrison recurrence; choose cached point maximum, no rechecks
protocol.structural_tie: verified current weighted-adjacency automorphism mapping candidate to competitor: endpoint permutation or exchange of rooted isomorphic components of at most40 vertices
protocol.numerical_tie: independent q96/tol1e-12 difference <1e-14 without an automorphism certificate is reported separately, never called structural
protocol.reference: high-accuracy q12/tol1e-12 compiled CELF; Small-BA additionally uses dense spectral greedy; tie-safe declared numerical tolerance
protocol.timing: classification, exact gain and cache audits excluded from all algorithm timings
